title: Is Your Body Whispering Today?
caption: Feeling jittery today? The sky is calm and steady, so there’s room to recover even if a light buzz hangs around. Keep plans simple, take slow breathing breaks and easy movement, and work in short stretches.
snapshot: Geomagnetic conditions look quiet and steady. Solar wind is moving faster, yet no flares or CMEs were noted. The Earth’s hum sits near its usual zone. Overall, it’s a low-signal day with a small bit of static.
affects: Some may feel a light buzz in the body even as things settle. Focus can come easier in short stretches. Others may just feel normal and steady. Carryover from the last few days can still be in the mix.
playbook:
- Keep plans simple and kind
- Take slow breathing breaks and easy movement
- Keep caffeine earlier in the day
- Choose softer light and sound when you can
